messages:
Noah: idea  ship a 2-week "mini-lab" sequence: three bite-sized tutorials + an OSS launch post. aim: fast wins + benchmark appendix.
Iris: love. keep copy super pragmatic. 5m quickstart, 15m integration, 25m optimize.
Cal: I'll run perf: tokens/sec, p50 latency, est $/1k tokens for baseline vs q4. will drop CSV in repo.
Rina: design to make 2 hero images and a short gif. marketing assets: 3-tweet thread + LinkedIn copy.
Noah: ops-bot  create a checklist and schedule 20m sync Thu 11am. invite closed beta (10 devs).
ops-bot: created task card at https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/mini-lab/board and event "mini-lab kickoff" Thu 11:00  invites sent to Noah, Iris, Cal, Rina.
Iris: also add a tiny eval harness and sample "expected outputs" file to catch regressions.
Cal: will tag runs with model + quant settings in the CSV. sample snippet for blog: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2","prompt":"Summarize..."}'`
Rina: draft both headlines for A/B: "Start in 5 minutes" vs "See real inference savings".
Noah: great. next: outlines due Tue EOD; perf runs Wed; QA + blog Thu; publish Fri + webinar next Tue.
